title: Heartbreak for India as Oz advance to semis after goalless Hockey WC draw
content: Indian women’s Hockey World Cup campaign ended after Australia held them to a 0-0 draw and advanced to the semifinals on goals scored. Australia had two goals ruled out after reviews, while India missed key chances and penalty corners. Despite a strong second-half push and removing their goalkeeper late on, India could not find the winner and will now play for fifth place.

title: What makes September 3 important for international students in the US on F and J visas
content: A federal court is scheduled to review arguments on September 3, 2026, concerning a newly proposed rule that overhauls the current 'duration of status' policy which impacts international students. The plaintiffs contend that this alteration fosters ambiguity and adversely affects educational institutions. They reference economic repercussions and dismiss comments from DHS.

title: Microsoft has a 6-word answer for students wondering if coding is still worth it
content: Microsoft Learn has told students on X that learning to code is worth it "now more than ever", even as AI writes a growing share of software. Satya Nadella says AI already produces up to 30% of Microsoft's code, while Google puts its figure at 75%. The skill has not died, it has shifted from writing syntax to reviewing, debugging and directing AI-generated code.

title: Thomas Markle 'hurt and upset' as Meghan returns to UK without meeting him
content: Meghan Markle’s estranged father Thomas Markle says he is “hurt and upset” after learning that Meghan and Prince Harry are reportedly returning to the UK with their children, Archie and Lilibet. The 82-year-old, who has never met his grandchildren, says he fears their move will end his hopes of ever meeting them.

title: Canada sinks retired Boeing 737 off Vancouver Island to create artificial reef
content: In an innovative environmental initiative, a Boeing 737 from Canadian Airlines has been transformed into an artificial reef off the coast of Chemainus, British Columbia. Sunk in 2006, this aircraft has undergone a thorough cleaning by dedicated volunteers before its descent. Now known as Xihwu Reef, it has become a thriving ecosystem, supporting over a hundred different marine species that benefit from the habitat provided by this repurposed aircraft.

title: Why ex-Google CEO Eric Schmidt is 'unhappy' with his former boss Sergey Brin
content: Eric Schmidt has expressed discontent regarding Sergey Brin's financial backing for political measures, which includes a staggering $100 million aimed at challenging California's Proposition 40. His irritation is exacerbated by investments in various ballot initiatives, particularly a wealth tax that impacts individuals boasting a net worth exceeding $1 billion. The former Google CEO is determined to thwart this proposed tax targeting billionaires.

title: Doctor assaulted by patient’s son inside Maharashtra hospital, FIR registered
content: An orthopaedic surgeon was assaulted by a patient's son at a private hospital late Saturday night, raising concerns among other patients present. This incident mirrors a previous attack on medical professionals by a local corporator just weeks prior. Authorities have filed a First Information Report (FIR) and are actively investigating this latest attack; the suspect from the prior incident is currently in Goa.

title: How Travis Kelce built $90 million fortune as podcast deal reshaped his wealth
content: Travis Kelce's net worth reaches ninety million dollars by 2026.  His NFL salary totals over one hundred eleven million dollars in career earnings.  A significant podcast deal with Amazon's Wondery is valued at one hundred million dollars.  Endorsement income and business ventures further boost his substantial financial portfolio.  His marriage to Taylor Swift has also broadened his commercial appeal.

title: Charlotte Flair vs Alexa Bliss net worth 2026: Who is richer among WWE stars?
content: Alexa Bliss and Charlotte Flair have earned a lot of money through WWE contracts, championships, merchandise, endorsements and media work. Flair is generally accepted to be wealthier, although Bliss has built up a strong commercial profile for herself. Both performers have not released complete financial records, so all of the net worth figures are estimates.

title: Tom Brady’s son Jack chooses basketball over football as breakout turns heads
content: Tom Brady’s eldest son, Jack Moynahan, is attracting attention for his rising basketball career rather than following his father into football. The 6-foot-6 athlete recently showcased his skills at The Newman School in Boston, prompting enthusiastic reactions from fans. His mother, Bridget Moynahan, previously said Jack was more interested in basketball and lacrosse. Now, his growing presence on the court suggests he is carving out a sporting identity of his own.

title: Asim Riaz denies ex-GF Himanshi Khurana’s Islam conversion allegation
content: Asim Riaz has firmly dismissed Himanshi Khurana's allegations regarding religious conversion during their previous romance, labeling such claims as childish. He clarified that he never pressured anyone to alter their faith. Himanshi recounted how Asim highlighted positive aspects of his religion, yet she felt that converting would betray her own beliefs. The couple, who first connected on Bigg Boss 13, ended their relationship in 2023.

title: Trump tariffs: What India can learn from Canada’s failed trade talks with US
content: Ottawa said it would introduce “dollar-for-dollar” retaliatory tariffs from September 8. The move brought an end to talks that had started on February 1, 2025, after the first round of new US tariffs was imposed.

title: From roses to stone and statues: Trump's makeover of White House Rose Garden
content: President Trump is making significant renovations to the White House grounds, highlighted by the addition of new statues in the Rose Garden. Among these is a bronze statue of Thomas Jefferson, placed alongside other notable American figures. This revitalization effort aims to modernize the historic garden while ensuring the preservation of the White House complex for future generations.

title: Rest, viral and not in India's XI for Colombo Test: Mysterious case of Kuldeep

Kuldeep did travel with the team and was also spotted in the dugout alongside Sarfaraz Khan. The official word from the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) remains "viral illness".

title: Meet Sir Nils Olav III, world's highest-ranking penguin, set to become a father
content: The world’s highest-ranking penguin, Major General Sir Nils Olav III, is set to become a father after his partner Connie laid an egg at Edinburgh Zoo. The surprise arrival marks the zoo’s first king penguin egg in 17 years. Keepers are closely monitoring the inexperienced parents as they take turns protecting and warming the egg.

title: ‘They may have fled to Odisha’: Mystery deepens in Tamil Nadu Express murder case

Investigators recovered more remains from the suspects' rented Chennai residence.  The couple is believed to have fled to Odisha after the discovery.  Authorities are working to determine the motive behind the gruesome killing.

title: Woman kills husband in brutal knife attack in Haryana, later jumps from rooftop

A post-mortem examination uncovered missing sections of his liver and right kidney. The couple had been residing together in Kurukshetra for approximately one year.

title: Yashasvi Jaiswal fight: 'Shouldn't have gone so close,' says India batting coach

Autopsy results are pending to establish the precise cause of their untimely deaths.

The win moved Durham to the top of the County Championship, with Stokes showing he remains a major all-round force.
